name: cloud-r2pan
description: cloud-r2pan - iOS 26 液态玻璃风格网盘分享系统 (Cloudflare Workers + R2 + D1)

scripts.test: esbuild "test/*.ts" --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.dev/test --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');const files=fs.readdirSync('.dev/test').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.mjs'));if(!files.length)throw new Error('no test bundles emitted');let bad=0;for(const f of files){console.log('=== '+f);if(cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['.dev/test/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'}).status!==0){bad++;console.error('FAILED '+f);}}if(bad)process.exit(1);"
